headline: Grant spending of $60,000 for residents facing loss of insurance coverage, and $30,000 for recycling and waste reduction programs.
summary: Two Fire Services SAFE grants would pay for fire and life safety lessons for students and seniors. Two other grants fund insurance coverage help and recycling programs.
items: Spend $6,114.64 from the Fire Services SAFE Grant on fire and life safety education for students
Spend about $2,444.64 from the Fire Services Senior SAFE Grant on fire and life safety education for seniors
Spend $60,000 from the Blue Cross Blue Shield of MA Foundation OB3 Defense Grant to help residents losing insurance coverage
Spend about $30,000 from the Mass DEP Sustainable Material Recovery Program Recycling Dividends Fund on reuse, recycling, and waste reduction in Fitchburg
location: Legislative Building, Fitchburg City Hall Campus, 700 Main Street, Fitchburg, MA 01420
transcript:
# CITY OF FITCHBURG

## NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING

### CITY COUNCIL FINANCE COMMITTEE

Filed in the City Clerk's Office

FITCHBURG CITY CLERK Nov 19 2026 1:02 pm

**MEETING DATE:** Wednesday, November 25, 2026

**MEETING TIME:** 6:00 ☐AM ☒PM

**MEETING PLACE:** FITCHBURG CITY HALL CAMPUS

Name of building (if applicable): Legislative Building

Room number (if applicable):

Address: 700 Main Street

City: Fitchburg, MA 01420

The meeting can also be viewed on FATV.org by choosing Government Live Stream, on Comcast Channel 9, or on Verizon Channel 36.

This meeting will be open to the public. Persons who wish to participate remotely in the Public Forum portion of the meeting may request a remote attendance meeting link by contacting the City Clerk at cityclerk@fitchburgma.gov prior to NOON on the day of the meeting.

**AGENDA ITEMS:**

- Announcement regarding recording of public meetings
- Public Forum

**COUNCIL AS A WHOLE MEETING**

193-26 ORDER: the City of Fitchburg hereby approves the expenditure of funds from the Department of Fire Services SAFE Grant in the approximate amount of SIX THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED FOURTEEN AND 64/100 DOLLARS ($6,114.64) for the purpose of delivering fire and life safety education to students in the city.

194-26 ORDER: the City of Fitchburg hereby approves the expenditure of funds from the Department of Fire Services Senior SAFE Grant in the approximate amount of TWO THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED FORTY-FOUR AND 64/100 DOLLARS ($2,444.64) for the purpose of delivering fire and life safety education to seniors in the city.

*Please note: Massachusetts Open Meeting Law requires that all topics that the Chair reasonably anticipates must be listed and that the list of topics must be sufficiently specific to reasonably inform the public of the issues to be discussed at the meeting.

195-26 ORDER: the City of Fitchburg approves the expenditure of grant funds from the Blue Cross Blue Shield of MA Foundation OB3 Defense Grant, in the amount of SIXTY THOUSAND DOLLARS ($60,000) to mitigate the number of residents experiencing loss of insurance coverage.

196-26 ORDER: the City of Fitchburg hereby approves the expenditure of grant funds from the Mass DEP Sustainable Material Recovery Program - Recycling Dividends Fund, in the approximate amount of THIRTY THOUSAND DOLLARS ($30,000) to implement programs and policies to maximize the reuse, recycling, and waste reduction of curbside and drop-off disposal in Fitchburg.

By Jacquelyn Cronin, Clerk, for Derrick J. Cruz, Chairman

** THIS NOTICE IS PROVIDED IN THE EVENT THAT A QUORUM OF THE CITY COUNCIL IS PRESENT AT THIS STANDING COMMITTEE MEETING, THEREBY CONSTITUTING A COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE. IF FEWER THAN A QUORUM OF THE CITY COUNCIL IS PRESENT, NO COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE MEETING SHALL BE CONVENED. IF A QUORUM IS PRESENT, THE COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE SHALL BE LIMITED STRICTLY TO THE STANDING COMMITTEE AGENDA ITEMS LISTED ABOVE.

*Please note: Massachusetts Open Meeting Law requires that all topics that the Chair reasonably anticipates must be listed and that the list of topics must be sufficiently specific to reasonably inform the public of the issues to be discussed at the meeting.
